name: ProposalClosing
description: The ask and sign-off: a final statement, an optional line, one action and a contact; contrast or quiet, with the brand's device through slots.
whenToUse: The last section of a proposal or report: the decision being asked for, one action, who to contact. 'contrast' lands it on an inverse band; 'quiet' closes on the page's own surface. The brand's device and page frame come through the heroDevice and pageFrame slots. Use the supplied ask; do not invent contact details.
